_readme: Real proof only. Nothing shows until it is filled in, and every change is written into the home page by the "Bake proof" GitHub action. quotes: { name (first name), role (e.g. "podcast host", "fitness creator"), photo (e.g. "site/img/q1.jpg", with their permission), text (one line with a specific outcome, e.g. "cut my Sunday edit to 20 minutes"), link (optional: their original post), linkLabel (optional) }. mentions: dated third-party mentions, shown between "What it won't do" and pricing: { name (e.g. "Product Hunt"), link (https), date ("2026-12-03" or "2026-12"), note (optional, e.g. "#4 Product of the Day"), badge (optional image path, e.g. "site/img/ph-badge.svg") }. avatars: early users' photos (with permission). cohort: e.g. "42 creators in the launch preview". reelsMade: only if you have a real number from before the live counter; the live count from Supabase is used once connected, and the count shows from 50.
